scope: Research and freeze source-backed Makati transport objects only. No Civic Map transport assets are added in this step.
researchPrinciples: Prefer current official operator, regulator, government or asset-owner sources.
Verify that the service/asset exists before treating it as a Civic Map candidate.
Do not invent point precision when a source proves the station/service but not a precise map coordinate.
Do not create a transport-route asset under the current point-only CivicAsset geometry because a single lat/lng would misrepresent a route.
Where two transport assets overlap physically, preserve mode-specific semantics but verify distinct points before adding separate pins.

supports: MRT-3 has four Makati stations: Guadalupe, Buendia, Ayala and Magallanes.
Current station schedules are published for those stations.
Station sequence and named MRT-3 stops, including the four Makati stations.
Guadalupe, Buendia and Ayala were operating EDSA Busway stations in January 2026.
sources.authority: government information source reporting DOTr/DICT rollout

supports: Guadalupe, Ayala and Buendia are established EDSA Busway stations and were among stations improved by DOTr/MMDA.
One Ayala contains an intermodal terminal.
The terminal serves P2P buses, UBE Express, city buses including EDSA Carousel, PUJs and UV Express.
The second level connects to MRT-3 Ayala Station.
The EDSA Busway Ayala stop is integrated with the One Ayala transport complex.

readyForImplementation.title: MRT-3 Guadalupe Station
readyForImplementation.pointPrecision: Verify station-center/entrance coordinate immediately before implementation; official sources confirm station identity/location along EDSA but do not publish a canonical lat/lng in the reviewed material.

readyForImplementation.title: MRT-3 Buendia Station
readyForImplementation.pointPrecision: Verify station-center/entrance coordinate immediately before implementation.

readyForImplementation.title: MRT-3 Ayala Station
readyForImplementation.pointPrecision: Verify station-center/entrance coordinate immediately before implementation.

readyForImplementation.title: MRT-3 Magallanes Station
readyForImplementation.pointPrecision: Verify station-center/entrance coordinate immediately before implementation.

readyForImplementation.title: One Ayala Terminal
readyForImplementation.pointPrecision: Use the transport-hub/terminal point rather than a generic mall centroid; verify against a current map before implementation.

verifiedButHoldForSecondBatch.title: EDSA Busway Guadalupe Station
verifiedButHoldForSecondBatch.holdReason: The station is verified, but it is physically close to MRT-3 Guadalupe. Verify a distinct median-platform point so Civic Map does not render a misleading duplicate station pin.

verifiedButHoldForSecondBatch.title: EDSA Busway Buendia Station
verifiedButHoldForSecondBatch.holdReason: The station is verified, but it is physically close to MRT-3 Buendia. Verify a distinct busway-platform point before implementation.

verifiedButHoldForSecondBatch.title: EDSA Busway Ayala Station
verifiedButHoldForSecondBatch.holdReason: Ayala Busway is integrated with the One Ayala transport complex. Do not add a separate point until the UI can distinguish the busway platform from One Ayala Terminal without confusing users.

deferFromCurrentPointModel.title: MRT-3 Makati segment
deferFromCurrentPointModel.reason: The route is verified, but CivicAsset currently stores one lat/lng rather than route geometry. A point would misrepresent a linear rail route.

deferFromCurrentPointModel.title: EDSA Busway Makati segment
deferFromCurrentPointModel.reason: The route is verified, but the current Civic Map data model has no polyline/route geometry.

notApprovedYet.candidate: Individual jeepney and UV Express routes from One Ayala
notApprovedYet.reason: One Ayala verifies that these modes use the terminal, but the reviewed authoritative sources do not provide a sufficiently stable current route-by-route inventory for Civic Map.

notApprovedYet.candidate: MRT Buendia–Mandaluyong City Hall road route
notApprovedYet.reason: An LTFRB route list was found from 2022, but that is not recent enough to treat the route as current without a newer confirmation.
It appears on the current Mobility page, but this research step prioritizes public-system/operator assets with stronger official/regulatory evidence before private-estate shuttle objects.

3C-4a.title: Add verified rail/intermodal transport assets
3C-4a.prerequisite: Verify current point coordinates immediately before coding; use source/address metadata on every asset.

3C-4b.title: Add EDSA Busway Makati stations
3C-4b.prerequisite: Verify distinct busway platform/station points and confirm the UI can distinguish them from adjacent MRT/One Ayala assets.

conclusion: The transport expansion should begin with four official MRT-3 Makati stations plus One Ayala Terminal. EDSA Busway Guadalupe, Buendia and Ayala are also verified current assets, but should be implemented separately after precise mode-specific points are checked. Route objects remain deferred until Civic Map supports route geometry.

nextStep.title: Add EDSA Busway Makati stations
nextStep.scope: Verify distinct platform points for Guadalupe, Buendia and Ayala and add only those three assets.
